extracted.name: Tomato Sauce Bread
extracted.description: Great recipe for Tomato Sauce Bread.
instruction_lines: Mix all the tomato sauce ingredients in a pan. Simmer 20 minutes and set aside. Preheat oven 450° Fahrenheit. Mix all the bread ingredients an knead for 5 minutes. Add to a baking pan sized 9×13, butter. Grease the pan. Add dough spreading it out like a pizza. Add sauce one top of the center and spread.
Put into oven 20-25 minutes. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!
